# The Conversation

> Expert-written research journalism and academic analysis on science, policy, culture, and current events from leading researchers and scholars worldwide.

The Conversation is a nonprofit news organization that publishes in-depth articles written by academics and researchers across multiple editions (US, Australia, Canada, Africa, and other languages). It covers major topics including science, technology, health, politics, environment, education, business, arts, and ethics with a focus on explaining complex issues through expert analysis.

## Key Topics

- research journalism
- expert analysis
- climate change
- geopolitics
- public health
- artificial intelligence
- policy impact
- environmental health
- social issues
- economics
- current events
- academic research
- Iran conflict
- technology
- education policy

## Topic Areas

- [Science + Technology](https://theconversation.com/us/technology): Science and technology coverage on AI, space, psychology, and research breakthroughs
- [Health + Medicine](https://theconversation.com/us/health): Health and medical research from doctors and scientists on wellness and disease
- [Environment + Energy](https://theconversation.com/us/environment): Climate, energy, and environmental coverage from researchers on sustainability
- [Politics + Society](https://theconversation.com/us/politics): Politics section with analysis from scholars on elections, policy, and government
- [Economy + Business](https://theconversation.com/us/business): Business and economics coverage from researchers on markets, policy, and industry
- [Education](https://theconversation.com/us/education): Education news covering K-12, higher ed, policy, and classroom technology
- [World](https://theconversation.com/us/world): Global news and geopolitical analysis from international relations experts
- [Arts + Culture](https://theconversation.com/us/arts): Arts and culture section with expert analysis on movies, music, theater, and media
- [Ethics + Religion](https://theconversation.com/us/ethics): Religion and ethics section with expert perspectives on belief, values, and practice

## US Edition

- [The Conversation U.S. - Home](https://theconversation.com/us/home-page): US homepage featuring expert-written research articles on science, policy, and social issues
- [The Conversation U.S.](https://theconversation.com/us): Main US site featuring research journalism and expert analysis on current issues
- [Local News and Analysis](https://theconversation.com/us/local): Local news and community analysis from Detroit, Pittsburgh, and Colorado regions

## International Editions

- [The Conversation Australia](https://theconversation.com/au): Australian edition featuring local politics, economics, climate, and cultural analysis
- [The Conversation Canada](https://theconversation.com/ca): Canadian edition with perspectives on indigenous issues, energy, AI, and geopolitics
- [La Conversation Canada (French)](https://theconversation.com/ca-fr): French-language Canadian edition with research articles on policy and social issues
- [The Conversation Africa](https://theconversation.com/africa): African edition with expert analysis on economics, climate, development, and policy
- [Català (Catalan)](https://theconversation.com/catalan): Catalan-language edition featuring academic articles on AI, society, and environment

## Audio & Multimedia

- [Podcasts](https://theconversation.com/us/podcasts): Audio content featuring The Conversation Weekly and expert-led podcast series
